source.publication: 2025 D-40 Booklet (Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions)
source.section: D-40 Lines 4-7, 15-20; booklet PDF page 19 Line 4; PDF page 20 Lines 16-17 and Calculation I/Tax Rate Schedule; Schedule S Calculation G-1 lines a-h (PDF page 51); standard deduction PDF pages 4 and 13 (record base.deductions cite); Line 10 taxable Social Security and tier 1 railroad retirement (PDF page 20 Line 10; D-40 form page 2 Line 10; record social_security_tier1_subtraction cite)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 25,000.00 + railroad retirement (you) 30,000.00 = 55,000.00. The railroad retirement is tier 2 benefits, 30,000.00 in federal AGI (given). Federal taxable income = 55,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 39,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). D-40 (single): Line 4 federal AGI 55,000.00. Line 5 franchise tax 0.00. Line 6 other additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 7 = 55,000.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 55,000.00. Line 10 taxable Social Security and tier 1 railroad retirement: railroad retirement 30,000.00 = 30,000.00. The projection exempts all railroad retirement (accepted approximation); the booklet's Line 10 names tier 1 only, so on the form the 30,000.00 tier 2 amount would stay taxed: Line 16 55,000.00, Line 19 40,000.00, tax 2,200.00 (table row 40,000-40,049 gives 2,202). Lines 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 0.00. Line 14 Schedule I Calculation B Line 16 0.00. Line 15 total subtractions = 30,000.00. Line 16 DC AGI = 55,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 25,000.00. Line 17 standard (same as federal). Line 18 from Schedule S Calculation G-1: line a basic 15,000.00; lines b and d age 65 (born before January 2, 1961): you age 63 (born 1962-01-20) does not count; line f 0; line g 2,000.00 x 0 = 0.00; line h 15,000.00 + 0.00 = 15,000.00. Line 19 DC taxable income = 25,000.00 - 15,000.00 = 10,000.00. Line 20 tax, Calculation I rate schedule as numbers: 4% x 10,000.00 = 400.00; total 400.00. (Taxable income is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 10,000-10,049, PDF page 95, gives 402; expected keeps the formula figure.) Lines 21-23 credits 0.00; Line 24 = 400.00.
accepted_approximations: Railroad retirement is exempted in full; the booklet's Line 10 names only tier 1, so tier 2 railroad retirement (taxed in DC) is exempted as well.
Tax on taxable income of 100,000 or less comes from the tax tables (50-dollar rows); the projection uses the rate schedule.
